definitions.explanation: A shop or store that is authorized to sell, service, or handle a particular product or brand. Commonly seen on signs and advertisements to indicate where specific products are available.

examples.japanese: {最寄|もよ}りの{取扱店|とりあつかいてん}を{探|さが}す。
examples.english: To look for the nearest authorized dealer.

examples.japanese: この{商品|しょうひん}は{全国|ぜんこく}の{取扱店|とりあつかいてん}で{購入|こうにゅう}できます。
examples.english: This product can be purchased at authorized dealers nationwide.

examples.japanese: ウェブサイトで{取扱店|とりあつかいてん}の{一覧|いちらん}を{確認|かくにん}してから{買|か}いに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I checked the list of retailers on the website before going to buy it.

examples.japanese: {正規|せいき}{取扱店|とりあつかいてん}でないと{保証|ほしょう}が{受|う}けられない{場合|ばあい}がある。
examples.english: In some cases, you cannot receive a warranty unless you buy from an authorized dealer.

notes:
Composed of {取扱|とりあつかい} (handling, dealing) and {店|てん} (shop, store). This is a very common term in Japanese retail, appearing on storefronts, product packaging, and brand websites to indicate officially authorized points of sale.

The word implies that the shop has an arrangement — formal or informal — with the manufacturer or brand to sell their products. Buying from a {取扱店|とりあつかいてん} often ensures warranty coverage and authenticity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正規|せいき}{取扱店|とりあつかいてん}: official authorized dealer
- {取扱店|とりあつかいてん}{一覧|いちらん}: list of authorized dealers
- {取扱店|とりあつかいてん}を{検索|けんさく}する: to search for dealers
- {最寄|もよ}りの{取扱店|とりあつかいてん}: nearest authorized dealer
- {取扱店|とりあつかいてん}{募集|ぼしゅう}: seeking authorized retailers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {販売店|はんばいてん}: sales outlet, retail shop — a general term for any shop that sells something; does not imply authorization
- {代理店|だいりてん}: agency, agent — a business that acts on behalf of another company, often with broader authority than a {取扱店|とりあつかいてん}
- {特約店|とくやくてん}: exclusive dealer, franchise — a shop with a special contract, often implying a closer or exclusive relationship with the brand
